## Thursday, 2026-11-19 | ERCOT Fleet: 32 BESS Nodes

---

## 1. PERFORMANCE SUMMARY

LONESTAR_RN was the singular spike outlier at **$147.41/MWh**, representing a local congestion event rather than a systemwide scarcity signal. The top DART performer was **PAVLOV_BT_RN**, where DA exceeded RT by **$25.95/MWh**, rewarding assets that committed to DA — CEDRVALE_RN (**+$12.16/MWh DA premium**), COYOTSPR_RN (**+$11.80**), and FAULKNER_RN (**+$11.80**) followed suit, all consistent with the renewable oversupply pattern suppressing RT prices at west/central nodes. The **7-day forecast is unambiguously bearish for RT prices** across the board: mild temperatures statewide (highs 51-84°F with no cold stress or heat stress), low to moderate precipitation probability through 11-21, and the structural backdrop of extreme renewable supply already demonstrated by yesterday's 45.6 GW combined wind+solar against 53.4 GW load.
